# Holdbyte — holder access to operator-funded AI

Display brand: Holdbyte.
Repository and compatibility identifiers: Slipvolt, sv_ customer keys, legacy grd_ keys,
SLIPVOLT_* environment variables, and gridraft_session cookie names remain valid.

Customer flow
- Hold the configured Solana project token.
- Sign a login-only wallet message.
- Create a revocable customer API key.
- Use a finite daily input-and-output token allowance.
- No on-chain key mint, second checkout, or automatic overage charge.

Useful routes
- Service stage and limits: GET /api/status
- Live usable models: GET /v1/models (503 when live verification is unavailable)
- Source-labelled model policy: GET /api/models
- Wallet allowance and usage: GET /api/membership
- Create a key: POST /api/member-key
- List or revoke keys: GET /api/keys, DELETE /api/keys/{id}
- Inference: POST /v1/chat/completions with Bearer sv_...
- Exact request schema: GET /openapi.json
- Recent usage export: GET /api/usage/export (wallet session; latest 100 records)

API scope
Text-only Chat Completions supports SSE streaming, function definitions, and returned
tool calls. Holdbyte never executes tools. Multimodal input, embeddings, Responses,
Assistants, file endpoints, and non-schema fields are unsupported.
More keys do not increase a wallet's allowance. The daily reset is 00:00 UTC with
no rollover. Unresolved reservations remain held for operator review.
Duplicate Idempotency-Key values return 409 and do not replay an earlier response.
Do not retry an uncertain provider result blindly.

Funding and custody
The Solana project token controls eligibility. Native GNK funds OpenBroker inference.
WGNK, provider credit, self-custody GNK, and the local allowance ledger are separate.
Do not enter an obk- provider credential or wallet seed in the customer site.
GET /api/network is sanitized aggregate OpenBroker activity, not Holdbyte usage.
Rate-card fields are operator planning inputs, not enabled checkout or customer prices.
No token mint, treasury transaction, bridge, swap, or funded inference is implied by
this repository. A launch link can appear only after an operator explicitly enables
the verified configured mint; that flag does not prove liquidity or service readiness.

Guides
- /developers/ — first request, model discovery, streaming, tools, and errors
- /help/ — setup, allowances, retries, account recovery, and safe support
- /funding/ — token, GNK, WGNK, custody, and accounting boundaries
- /privacy/ — records, processors, retention limits, and account controls
- /terms/ — draft holder-access and service rules
